events.text: {npc} stands in your path on the market road. 'Our families have hated each other for longer than either of us has been alive. Shall we end it, or go on?'

mem.note: beat me on the market road

ok.log: You win. {npc} spits blood and laughs. 'Not ended. Paused.'

mem.note: lost to me on the market road

fail.log: {npc} wins and walks away without a word. The feud has a new chapter.

choices.text: Offer to end it with tea

mem.note: offered to end our families' feud

effects.log: {npc} stares at you for a long time, then sits down. Three generations of hatred, and nobody remembers how it started.

events.text: {npc} sends you a letter: a list of every wrong your family has done to {his} family, going back three generations. Some of it is even true.

choices.text: Write back an honest apology for the true parts

effects.log: {npc} does not answer for a year. Then a single line arrives: 'Noted.' It is a start.
The letters go back and forth for years. It is, in its way, the longest friendship of your life.

events.text: {npc} comes to your home with a jar of wine and no weapons. 'My grandfather would kill me. I do not care any more.'

effects.log: You sit up over tea until dawn and tell each other your families' versions of every story. They never match. The feud ends that night.
